_rule: Frozen baseline of hand-stamped color literals that the theme compiler did NOT emit. design/check.mjs Part E re-counts each file and FAILS on ANY drift from `count` — growth (a new literal) OR shrink (a literal was tokenized). A ratchet: every change to a file's literal count MUST update its baseline in THIS SAME DIFF. The ledger only shrinks over time; it can never silently grow. Counting rule lives next to the implementation in design/check.mjs Part E (LEDGER_LITERAL regex + stripLedgerNoise): a color literal is `#hex` (3-8 digits) or an rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() whose first argument is NOT var() — `hsl(var(--x))` is compiler-driven token consumption, not a hand-stamp, so it is excluded (this is what lets a literal→var conversion register as a shrink). Marker regions (BEGIN/END GENERATED: tokens) and comments (CSS /* */, HTML <!-- -->, HEEx <%!-- --%> and <%# %>) are blanked before counting, so the emitted block and e.g. the `#940` PR-ref in app.css never count.
_note: The per-file `count` splits as {hex + literal-rgb/rgba + literal-hsl}. These are the surfaces still holding hand-stamped color the theme-system compiler has not yet reached; as tokenization lands, LOWER the number here in the same diff.
